lines: From the world's inside, winning Thee — again, from Thine inside, they win this. World-Lord —
Thine alone, love-sharers: for naught of theirs here is from afar.
sanskrit_cite: jagato 'ntarato bhavantam āptvā punar etad bhavato 'ntarāl labhante jagadīśa tavaiva bhaktibhājo na hi teṣām iha dūrato 'sti kiñcit

lines: Here Thou, there Bhavānī — all-things'-rank-pregnant, first.
But at truth's station, neither Hers nor Thine, nor triple-world's, is split.
sanskrit_cite: kvacid eva bhavān kvacid bhavānī sakalārthakramagarbhiṇī pradhānā paramārthapade tu naiva devyā bhavato nāpi jatattrayasya bhedaḥ

lines: The smug know not the lovely even; though try-favored, all things indeed. But mind —
though risen this even — kens not self-shape here. Ah! then — ah! — I am slain.
sanskrit_cite: no jānate subhagam apy avalepavanto lokāḥ prayatnasubhagā nikhila hi bhāvāḥ cetaḥ punar yad idam udyatam apy avaiti naivātmarūpam iha hā tad aho hato 'smi

lines: Thy feet honored with full wealth, won by dwelling in Thee-made self —
who needs not food nor cloak ever: to him bowed am I.
sanskrit_cite: bhavanmayasvātmanivāsalabdhasampadbharābhyarcitayuṣmadaṅghriḥ na bhojanācchādanam apy ajasram apekṣate yas tam ahaṃ nato 'smi

lines: Ever in Thy-frame-dwelling hale, yet inside supremely burns this world.
By Thy will, so do for me that here, Thy-worship-joy-made, I be.
sanskrit_cite: sadā bhavaddehanivāsasvastho 'py antaḥ paraṃ dahyata eṣa lokaḥ tavecchayā tat kuru me yathātra tvadarcanānandamayo bhaveyam

lines: By own sap risen — Thy-lotus-feet-pair-worship-nectar-drink-glued-mind —
'mid all-aims'-gatherings may I be, touch-joy-alone for world-faring.
sanskrit_cite: svarasoditayuṣmadaṅghripadmadvayapūjāmṛtapānasaktacittaḥ sakārthacayeṣv ahaṃ bhaveyam sukhasaṃsparśanamātralokayātraḥ

lines: In all-dealings'-pasture, plain — within throbs, in Thee, Ruler.
They near and leave ever — my things, shine they ever.
sanskrit_cite: sakalavyavahāragocare sphuṭam antaḥ spurati tvayi prabho upayānty apayānti cāniśam mama vastūni vibhāntu sarvadā

lines: Ever in Thine own city — or cityless, roaming with Thee:
not a wink's crumb even be mine of defeat, forsooth, where Thee-made.
sanskrit_cite: satatam eva tavaiva pure 'thavāpy arahito vicareyam ahaṃ tvayā kṣaṇalavo 'py atha mā sma bhavet sa me na vijaye nanu yatra bhavanmayaḥ

lines: In Thy-limb-oozed well-cool-nectar-floods brimmed, all round even —
in Thy-worship-wealth here, Thy lovers in passing's lake within roam.
sanskrit_cite: bhavadaṅgaparisravatsuśītāmṛtapūrair bharite samantato 'pi bhavadarcanasampadeha bhaktās tava saṃsārasaro 'ntare caranti

lines: In great-chant-tree-shade-cool, in Thy high woods,
in mine own self ever, Ruler, may I dwell, Thy honorer.
sanskrit_cite: mahāmantratarucchāyāśītale tvanmahāvane nijātmani sadā nātha vaseyaṃ tava pūjakaḥ

lines: To each thing of all breathers Thou dawnest, dawn-made —
as. So, my Ruler, forth to show fare, three-eyes-trident-graced.
sanskrit_cite: prativastu samastajīvataḥ pratibhāsi pratibhāmayo yathā mama nātha tathā puraḥ prathāṃ vraja netratrayaśūlaśobhitaḥ

lines: From pride-cake-offering, by mine-love's-weight built —
gladdened, when wilt Thou be my eyes' ground everywhere?
sanskrit_cite: abhimānacarūpahārato mamatābhaktibhareṇa kalpitāt paritoṣagataḥ kadā bhavān mama sarvatra bhaved dṛśaḥ padam

lines: Dwelling in high-nectar-sea's middle, in Thy-honor-rule-alone sunk-mind —
all folk-faring may I ply, savoring, everywhere indeed, aught even.
sanskrit_cite: nivasanparamāmṛtābdhimadhye bhavadarcāvidhimātramagnacittaḥ sakalaṃ janavṛttam ācareyaṃ rasayan sarvata eva kiñcanāpi

lines: Thine here — be thing, be truth. To bare it, who here is vessel fit? This alone —
name-shape-stir-and-the-rest-unequalled of Thine — takes. Taker art Thou, since.
sanskrit_cite: bhavadīyam ihāstu vastu tattvaṃ vivarītuṃ ka ivātra pātram arthe idam eva hi nāmarūpaceṣṭādyasamaṃ te harate haro 'si yasmāt

lines: For calm, no joy-hunger a jot — in love-heaped-frenzies. Freedom-wooing's fruit even —
no begging minded, before the heart-thief.
sanskrit_cite: śāntaye na sukhalipsutā manāg bhaktisambhṛtamadeṣu taiḥ prabhoḥ mokṣamārgaṇaphalāpi nārthanā smaryate hṛdayahāriṇaḥ puraḥ

lines: Wake-or-other-state, or high — whatever even, a jot of standing: for love-bowl-folk, all is —
Thou-lorded-mind's — high feast.
sanskrit_cite: jāgaretaradaśāthavā parā yāpi kācana manāg avasthiteḥ bhaktibhājanajanasya sākhilā tvatsanāthamanaso mahotsavaḥ

lines: O mind — eye-ring's turns, everywhere slack-turned even, they —
Thee winning, hard-long-knowing, Ruler — by love-hoard's heat? How?
sanskrit_cite: āmano 'kṣavalayasya vṛttayaḥ sarvataḥ śithilavṛttayo 'pi tāḥ tvām avāpya dṛḍhadīrghasaṃvido nātha bhaktidhanasoṣmaṇāṃ katham

lines: Nor sundered was unmade aught — yet unjoy here was never built.
Yet pained and parted in all ways — O matchless-wonder-home, bow be to Thee.
sanskrit_cite: na ca vibhinnam asṛjyata kiñcid asty atha sukhetarad atra na nirmitam atha ca duḥkhi ca bhedi ca sarvathāpy asamavismayadhāma namo 'stu te

lines: Thought-stain washed bright by splashed denial-blade-nectar-filling —
doubt-foe unconquered crushed: Thy beholding be unbroken.
sanskrit_cite: kharaniṣedhakhadāmṛtapūraṇocchalitadhautavikalpamalasya me dalitadurjayasaṃśayavairiṇas tvadavalokanam astu nirantaram

lines: Plain, enter me — then may I enter, ever, Ruler — Thine am I, since.
With rush Thy frame itself — outright, high-neared — may I honor.
sanskrit_cite: sphuṭam aviśa mām athāviśeyaṃ satataṃ nātha bhavantamasmi yasmāt rabhasena vapus tavaiva sākṣāt paramāsattigataḥ samarcayeyam

lines: In Thee no praise-might is any one's — or is indeed, since passing-fair art Thou.
Ever again my begged is this: that restless I behold the Ruler.
sanskrit_cite: tvayi na stutiśaktir asti kasyāpy athavāsty eva yato 'tisundaro 'si satataṃ punar arthitaṃ mamaitad yad aviśrānti vilokayeyam īśam
